objective: Characterize whether the registered Film Grunge and Film Damage pixel equations commute when stacked, and describe their combined color/detail and alpha-association response on the same fixed translucent fixture.

scope.method: Offline NumPy model of the exact isolated per-pixel equations using authored fixed diagnostic scratch/dust fields; compare disabled, individual effects and both orders.

comparison.baseline: Same fixture with both effects disabled and matching alpha association; arithmetic baseline only, not a desired look.
comparison.ground_truth: No external or approved target. Fixed synthetic overlay fields isolate equation order; they are not captured product placements or aesthetic references.
comparison.acceptance: Descriptive only. Compute exact model order commutator and alpha/composite response. Do not infer quality, product output or defect severity from nonzero order difference.

materials.fixture: Generated smooth translucent ellipse with zero RGB outside alpha, warm/cool flat patches, checker/line detail and a near-white patch. Fixed diagnostic Grunge scalar damageField and Film Damage RGBA damage overlay use separate labeled scratch/dust masks.
materials.rights: Generated locally by the study script.
materials.identity: Fixture and per-field hashes are stored in metrics; plan, sources, runner, previews and metrics are SHA-256 recorded.

regions.damage_marks: fixed Film Damage overlay alpha nonzero
regions.overlap_crop: 64x64 pixels centered at normalized (.61,.50), clipped to image bounds
regions.alpha_edge_crop: 64x64 pixels centered at normalized (.89,.50), clipped to image bounds

conditions.numeric_domain: Float32 BGRA storage, logical RGB direct numeric [0,1], no transfer conversion, exposure or display transform. No output clamp in either modeled equation.
conditions.alpha: Generate straight fixture, then premultiply RGB for the matched premultiplied branch. Each effect preserves source alpha. Straight source-over=storedRGB*alpha+background*(1-alpha); premultiplied source-over=storedRGB+background*(1-alpha). Test black, numeric linear gray .18 and white.
conditions.effect_controls: Film Grunge: grainAmount=0, scratch/dust controls bypassed in favor of authored damageField, flicker=0, gateWeave=0, vignette=0, stain=0. Film Damage: grain=0, dust/scratches generators bypassed in favor of authored RGBA overlay, gateWeave=0, flicker=0, filmBurn=0.
conditions.fixed_fields: Grunge signed scalar field is added to each RGB channel. Film Damage field uses its own fixed RGB and alpha, then source*(1-overlayAlpha)+overlayRGB*overlayAlpha. Both fields are held identical between single/stack/order conditions and across alpha associations. Mark centers follow normalized positions while stroke widths and dust radii stay fixed in pixels, matching source scale behavior. One-pixel Film Damage scratches cross Grunge scratches at normalized x=.61 (opaque-interior order ROI) and x=.89 (alpha-transition order ROI).
metrics: stored RGB min/max and below-zero/above-one channel rate
per-region order-paired RGB/composite MAE/RMSE/p95/max over three backgrounds
conditions.display: Direct-clipped RGB8 full/contact and detail crops; raw float outputs and metrics are authoritative.

effect_correctness.method: Verify the additive Grunge RGB equation, Damage overlay equation, source-alpha preservation, same fixed fields across candidates, and zero-field identity.
effect_correctness.acceptance_criteria: Disabled controls reproduce the source exactly within float tolerance; fixed fields and fixture match across stack/order conditions. No compiled parity claim.

image_quality_and_detail.method: Inspect the same-scale full contact sheet and 64x64 pixel crops centered at normalized (.61,.50) over the intersecting scratches and (.89,.50) at the ellipse alpha transition; enlarge crops with nearest-neighbor to 256x256. Report residual placement and contrast change by order.
image_quality_and_detail.acceptance_criteria: No aesthetic pass/fail; order difference alone is not a defect.

color_and_alpha.method: Compare alpha-preserving outputs under correctly constructed straight and premultiplied fixtures and composite over black/gray/white.
color_and_alpha.unverified: Actual input descriptor, downstream handling of Grunge Unknown alpha, and product compositing output.

temporal_stability.reason: Fields are fixed for this spatial order study; randomized per-frame marks and temporal output are excluded.

render_paths_and_resolution.method: Use two dimensions with same normalized fixture layout and scale diagnostic mark coordinates/widths with resolution.
render_paths_and_resolution.unverified: Actual route, preview/final mapping, compiled implementation and Viewer output.

performance.reason: No product timing, allocation or memory profiling.

execution.backend: Python 3 and NumPy/Pillow, offline synthetic model only.
execution.threshold_policy: Descriptive only; no unsupported perceptual threshold or preferred order is invented.
execution.reproducibility: Fixed procedural fixture and diagnostic fields, recorded package versions and source/plan/runner/artifact hashes.

amendments.reason: The initial exploratory model placed the fixed Film Damage scratch away from Grunge marks, leaving the registered overlap ROI empty and the order commutator trivially zero.
amendments.change: Move one fixed Film Damage scratch to normalized x=.61 so it crosses a fixed Grunge scratch; preserve pixel stroke widths and all fixtures, controls, regions and metrics. Re-run the complete comparison. Preserve the initial metrics as exploratory evidence.
amendments.impact: Initial disjoint-field metrics are not final order-interaction evidence. Final metrics use the amended fixed field and still do not represent randomized product placements.

amendments.reason: The full contact sheet and first completed order metrics show that the order response is localized around intersecting marks; the preregistered visual method names fixed crops but had not specified their coordinates or display enlargement.
amendments.change: Freeze two 64x64 pixel crops at normalized centers (.61,.50) for the intersecting scratches and (.89,.50) for the alpha transition, displayed enlarged 4x with nearest-neighbor. Keep all candidates, conditions and acceptance criteria unchanged.
amendments.impact: Adds reproducible detail evidence only; no thresholds or quality decisions change.

amendments.reason: The .89 alpha-edge crop had no overlapping fixed marks, so the order commutator there was zero by construction and could not describe edge order response.
amendments.change: Add a paired Grunge/Damage one-pixel scratch at normalized x=.89 spanning normalized y=.12-.88, while retaining the .61 opaque-interior crossing. Preserve all controls, candidate orders, ROIs, metrics and acceptance criteria; rerun every condition.
amendments.impact: The amended model now exercises order interaction in both opaque and alpha-transition regions. The prior interior-only metrics remain preserved as exploratory evidence.
